scope: evaluate the complete three-candidate Compression Director v1.1 family through authoritative full-session rerenders, Perceptual Critic and Autonomous Iteration without ranking or baseline promotion

implementation.survivor_meaning: level-matched audition reached human-listening gate only

real_audio_experiment.important_scope: additional processed-stage compression; not replacement of the original raw-track compressor

failures_and_limits: all three post-local vocal compression hypotheses failed the existing +0.02 full-mix vocal-intelligibility improvement gate
the experiment does not show that compression is musically worse; it shows that stacking extra compression after the original local vocal chain did not clear the objective proxy threshold
current Belye Stai SessionRenderer cannot replace the original raw/local compressor because its insert point is after local processing
next_goal: Belye Stai Local Vocal Processor Adapter v1: expose raw VALERA_VOX local EQ/expansion/ride/compression/de-ess/level as a deterministic reusable stage with compressor replacement hooks, prove no-change reproduction of the accepted processed VALERA_VOX, then evaluate Compression Director candidates at the original compressor position through the exact full-session renderer
